en.description:
Your Digital Crown is the steering wheel.

Crown Drive is an endless car racing game built for Apple Watch. Turn the Crown to steer through traffic, collect coins, and chase your next high score in quick, challenging runs.

THREE WAYS TO DRIVE

Classic: Find the gaps in a neon-lit stream of traffic as speed and difficulty increase.

Black Ice: Steer early and countersteer through slippery patches. Drift close to passing cars for bonus points.

Night Run: Follow your headlights into the dark. Tap BEAM for a short burst of wider visibility, then collect coins to help recharge it.

MAKE EVERY RUN COUNT

Collect consecutive coins to build a multiplier up to x4. Earn bonuses for close passes and grab shields to survive a collision. Each mode keeps its own high score.

MADE FOR YOUR WRIST

Enjoy continuous Digital Crown steering, quick sessions, and offline play directly on Apple Watch. Pause and resume when you need a break. No account required.
en.releaseNotes: WatchCarGame is now Crown Drive! Discover our refreshed home screen with a clearer guide to steering with the Digital Crown. Enjoy the same Classic, Black Ice, and Night Run modes, with your high scores preserved.
en.subtitle: Dodge traffic. Drift on ice.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: This app has been updated by Apple to prepare for watchOS 27 compatibility. No new features are included.

WatchCarGame 2.0 brings new roads, new challenges, and a fresh neon look!
• NEW: Black Ice — tackle slippery roads, control your drifts, and earn bonus points for close passes.
• NEW: Night Run — race through the darkness and use your high beams to reveal the road ahead.
• Redesigned neon graphics, detailed cars, and a new app icon.
• Steer exclusively with the Digital Crown in every mode.
• Collect coins, build score multipliers, and grab shields to keep your run going.
• Chase separate high scores in Classic, Black Ice, and Night Run.
Fixed an issue where oncoming cars appeared to drive backwards. Traffic now faces the correct direction in all game modes.

WatchCarGame is now Crown Drive! Discover our refreshed home screen with a clearer guide to steering with the Digital Crown. Enjoy the same Classic, Black Ice, and Night Run modes, with your high scores preserved.
